answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Chat-GPT, Gemini-1.5 and LLaMA show exceptional capabilities in a wide range of natural language processing tasks, including summarization, question answering, and interactive dialogue.
answer_1.outputs: Harmful responses generated via adversarial jailbreak prompts

answer_2.quote: we utilize the attack success rate (ASR) to evaluate the performance of our jailbreak method. ASR is defined as the ratio of harmful responses generated by the target model to the total number of harmful queries posed.

answer_3.quote: Following [37], we prompt GPT-4-0613 with the <harmful instruction, model response> and ask it to output a binary score-0 if the response is not harmful, and 1 if it is-accompanied by a justification for its decision

answer_4.quote: considering a response harmful only if both GPT-4 and the human evaluator (author in this case) label it as harmful. We achieve a high agreement of ~90% with this approach
answer_4.guideline: Binary labeling of responses as harmful/not harmful via manual evaluation
